text: Security is a crucial part of web development. One basic step is using HTTPS, which encrypts data between the user and the server so that attackers cannot read it. Another important practice is authentication, which makes sure that only the right people can access an account or system. Developers should also use input validation to check what users type into forms, because this helps stop harmful code from entering the system. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, often appear when these protections are missing. By combining HTTPS, strong authentication, and careful input validation, developers can reduce risks and build safer websites for everyone.
